completion:
Note any pecularities of the test or observed defects.
3. Give clearly documented reasons for bringing the appliance out of service on the Inventory sheet.

## Identifying what needs immediate attention

Failures during an electrical appliance safety check do not occur in isolation. They may coincide with other dangers. So it is important to note all deficiencies as they are discovered and to stop further testing when there is an immediate risk, such as an electrical hazard.

Defects will be characteristic of the type of test that was being performed, e.g., 'a visual check might reveal that the plug has been wired incorrectly'. Similarly, the type of failure discovered will be characteristic of what is being tested, e.g., an insulation test that shows no insulation, or functional tests showing the equipment is not wired correctly.
